i'm curious on why we don't choose not to adopt more PureComponent?
Any reason for this @algolia/instantsearch-for-websites ?
It hasn't proved necessary / useful to use PureComponent when we tried it the previous time. Note that this is Preact, not React, so they don't behave exactly the same

Inside the connector we often times create new functions (e.g. refine) on each render so the `PureComponent` check would fail every time. It means that we will do the check for nothing (not in that case though). But as @Haroenv said until we have performance issues then we can stick with functional component.
